name: Meiotic double-strand break formation and recombination
rationale: All members cover initiation, repair and resolution of programmed DSBs in meiosis I recombination, unlike confusables about meiotic cohesion/segregation or mitotic DNA repair.

name: p53 and CDC25A turnover with CDK inhibition
rationale: Members concern ubiquitin degradation of p53, CDC25A and COP1 plus dephosphorylation and CDK inhibition, whereas confusables emphasize radiation-induced checkpoint signaling and p53 phosphorylation.

name: Mitochondrial protein processing, turnover and cristae organization
rationale: Members share mitochondrial protein targeting, processing and degradation plus cristae and outer-membrane remodeling, distinguishing them from confusables on MCU calcium import or inner-membrane insertion.

name: Homologous recombination-based DNA repair and checkpoints
rationale: Members center on recombinational DSB repair (strand invasion, BIR, SDSA, sister chromatid exchange) with checkpoint and mitotic links, unlike confusables focused on Fanconi, telomeres or replication-fork stress.

qualifier: canonical and non-canonical, with ligand secretion
name: Canonical and non-canonical Wnt signaling and ligand secretion
rationale: All members concern Wnt signaling (beta-catenin destruction complex and its oncogenic mutants, Ca2+ branch, ligand biogenesis), distinguishing them from Norrin/FZD4, Notch, Hedgehog and Hippo confusables.

name: Telomere capping and recombination-based telomere maintenance
rationale: Members cover telomere capping, protection from NHEJ, t-circle/D-loop handling and recombination or replication-based maintenance, unlike confusables on replication-fork stress or telomerase inhibition.

name: Proteasome assembly and degron-directed proteasomal degradation
rationale: Members center on proteasome assembly, structure and N-/C-degron or ubiquitin-independent proteasomal catabolism, whereas confusables cover ubiquitination, DUBs, ERAD and autophagy.

qualifier: optic cup, optic nerve and ganglion-cell axons
name: Eye morphogenesis and retinal ganglion cell axon guidance
rationale: All members describe camera-type eye morphogenesis (optic cup, retina, iris, eyelid, pigmentation), with optic nerve and RGC axon guidance distinguishing it from lens/cornea, photoreceptor and inner-ear confusables.

name: Bone marrow hematopoiesis and thymocyte development
rationale: Members regulate bone marrow hematopoietic cells and thymic T cell proliferation, apoptosis and selection, which distinguishes them from confusables on HSC proliferation and myeloid differentiation.

name: MyD88-dependent TLR and inflammasome-driven inflammatory cytokine production
rationale: Members cover TLR2/4/5 MyD88/IRAK4 signaling, LPS detection, NLRP1/3 inflammasomes and IL-1/IL-6/TNF regulation, unlike TRIF, NOD, myeloid-module or IL-10 confusables.

qualifier: eIF3 complex and start codon scanning
name: eIF3-mediated translation initiation complex formation and scanning
rationale: All members concern initiation complex formation, eIF3 and scanning/start codon recognition, distinct from confusables on ternary/43S assembly, termination, NMD or ribosome biogenesis.

name: HSF1-mediated heat shock response and its attenuation
rationale: All members describe HSF1 activation, regulation and attenuation of the cellular heat response, unlike p53, stress granule or senescence confusables.

name: PAPS sulfate donor metabolism and chondrodysplasia-causing defects
rationale: Members concern PAPS synthesis/transport and sulfation-substrate defects (PAPSS2, SLC26A2, SLC35D1) causing skeletal dysplasias, unlike confusables on GAG biosynthesis, nucleotide sugar transport or selenium metabolism.

qualifier: spindle midzone and Rho GTPase-driven cytokinesis
name: Spindle midzone assembly and Rho GTPase-driven cytokinesis
rationale: Members cover spindle elongation, midzone assembly and Rho-regulated cytokinesis, distinguishing them from confusables on spindle checkpoint, PLK1 and Aurora A.

name: Neuropeptide regulation of sleep, stress and social behaviors
rationale: Members link neuropeptides (orexin, relaxin, CRH) to sleep/wake, stress, mating, aggression and parental behavior, unlike opioid synaptic signaling or HPA hormone secretion confusables.

name: Locomotor, sensorimotor and vocal behavior control
rationale: Members concern locomotion, reflexes, touch/proprioception, vocalization and the motor circuits (striatum, cerebellum, glycinergic inhibition) supporting them, unlike MECP2-transcription and neurotrophic confusables.

qualifier: IRF3 activation, HSE deficiencies and necroptosis
name: TLR3-TRIF antiviral signaling, HSE deficiencies and necroptosis
rationale: Members cover endosomal TLR3/TRIF signaling to TBK1-IRF3/7, its HSE-causing deficiencies and RIPK1/ZBP1 necroptosis, distinguishing them from RIG-I/interferon and TAK1/NF-kB confusables.

name: Monocyte TLR2/4 bacterial ligand sensing and inflammatory response
rationale: Members cover LPS/lipopeptide/LTA detection via TLR2/4/5-MyD88 and monocyte/myeloid inflammatory modules, unlike NOD-receptor, inflammasome cytokine or myeloid-immunity confusables.

qualifier: IL-6 family and common gamma/beta chain cytokines
name: IL-6-family and common gamma/beta-chain cytokine JAK-STAT signaling
rationale: Members cover IL-6/LIF/CNTF, IL-2/7/9 and IL-3/5 receptor signaling via STAT and SHC-ERK, distinguishing them from IL-10/12/23/27, EPO/FLT3 and IL-11 confusables.

name: COPI, endosome-to-Golgi and Golgi-to-lysosome vesicle traffic
rationale: Members center on COPI and retrograde endosome/Golgi/ER traffic plus Golgi-to-lysosome delivery, unlike COPII ER-exit, secretion or recycling confusables.

name: Integrin, Rap1 and G12/13-Rho signaling to MAPK cascades
rationale: Members link integrin adhesion and cytoskeletal remodeling with Rap1, G12/13-Rho and RAS/ERK5 MAPK signaling, unlike ILK/ROCK, shear-stress or platelet-agonist confusables.

name: Sema3A axon repulsion and collateral sprouting control
rationale: Members cover Sema3A-plexin repulsion, axon extension and collateral sprouting regulation, distinguishing them from netrin, ephrin/Sema4D and regeneration confusables.

name: Triglyceride storage, lipid droplet dynamics and lipolysis
rationale: Members center on TAG/DAG/PA synthesis, lipid droplet formation and breakdown, and lipolysis in adipose, unlike adipocyte differentiation, glycerol, fatty acid oxidation or phospholipid remodeling confusables.

qualifier: protein import and very-long-chain fatty acid oxidation
name: Peroxisomal protein import and very-long-chain fatty acid oxidation
rationale: Members cover peroxisomal matrix/membrane protein import and VLCFA beta-oxidation (including ALD), distinguishing them from pexophagy and medium-chain fatty acid confusables.

name: Oncogenic RAS/RAF mutant-driven MAP2K-MAPK activation
rationale: All members describe MAPK activation by RAS, BRAF and RAF1 mutants, unlike confusables on MAPK negative feedback or MRAS-SHOC2 RAF activation.
